description.value:
Over 10 minutes, you ward up to 2,500 square feet of floor space, a 50-foot square or an equivalent combination of smaller areas, up to 20 feet tall and shaped as you choose; the warded space may be split across multiple stories of a stronghold provided you can walk through each contiguous section while casting. You may exempt specific individuals from any or all of the ward's effects, and you may set a password that grants immunity to anyone who speaks it aloud.

Once active, you can trigger the following effects within the warded area with no action required.

Corridors. Fog heavily obscures every warded corridor, and at each junction there is a 50 percent chance a creature other than you believes it is heading the wrong way.

Doors. Every door in the area locks as though sealed by *lock*; up to ten of them can also be disguised to look like plain wall sections, using an illusory image comparable to *minor hologram*.

Stairs. Every stairway is coated in electromesh, as the *electromesh* power, which regrows within 10 minutes if cleared away while this power lasts.

Additional effect. You may also place one of the following: *mobile lights* in up to four corridors following a simple repeating pattern; *implant message* in up to two spots; or *debilitating gas* in up to two spots, which reforms within 10 minutes if dispersed.

The entire warded area radiates power, though a *diminish tech* aimed at one specific effect removes only that effect. Casting this power in the same stronghold daily for a year makes its wards permanent.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
